title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Greyserman Withdraws
items.text: Max Greyserman withdrew from the Butterfield Bermuda Championship during Friday’s second round due to a back injury, impacting his 2027 PGA Tour status pursuit.

items.headline: Choi Strong at LPGA Korea
items.text: Hye-Jin Choi shot 6-under 66 with an eagle and seven birdies to tie for second, four shots behind leader Haeran Ryu at 17-under 199 after three rounds.
